sloka: अस्तम् अभ्यगमत् सूर्यो रजनी च अभ्यवर्तत ।सा त्रि यामा तथा आर्तस्य चन्द्र मण्डल मण्डिता ॥२-१३-१५॥
transliteration: astam abhyagamat sūryo rajanī ca abhyavartata ।sā tri yāmā tathā ārtasya candra maṇḍala maṇḍitā ॥2-13-15॥

translations.english: For the king who was in deep anguish and in tears the night appeared dark even though it was adorned with the lunar orb.
